title: Interior and Exterior Angles of Polygons
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through interior and exterior angles of polygons.
definition: A simple polygon with n sides has interior angle sum (n−2)×180°. For a convex polygon, the exterior turning angles sum to 360°. A regular polygon has equal sides and equal interior angles, so each exterior angle is 360°/n.
